name: VTK.js Volume Rendering with Transfer Functions
aliases: VTK Volume Rendering with Transfer Functions
definition: A volume rendering technique implemented in VTK.js that uses a volume actor, volume mapper, and transfer functions (color and opacity) to render 3D scalar field data (volumes) in a WebGL/WebGPU context.
summary: VTK.js Volume Rendering with Transfer Functions is a browser-based GPU rendering technique that uses a declarative JavaScript API to configure piecewise color and gradient-based opacity mappings for 3D scalar fields.
